source: Dietary Analysis Assignment rubric, BIOL 45.01W (Dr. Gillian Schultz), transcribed 2026-09-25

vaguePortions.why: "Do not just put “1 serving” or similar."
A size is not a measured portion.

cutRequired.why: Which cut — leg, thigh or breast? And skin on or off?

tips: Include every food and drink, and be as specific as you can. Chicken — leg, thigh or breast? Skin on or off?
Estimate the portion as carefully as you can: ½ cup rice, 10 potato chips, 2 oz tofu.
Record how it was cooked or prepared. Was the potato peeled? Was the chicken skinless? Baked or fried?
Include anything added to it — ketchup, mustard, salad dressing.
Record all snacks, beverages and desserts.
Fast food is usually already in the database. Search by the item: "hamburger", "cheesecake".
Break mixed dishes into their parts. A tuna sandwich is 2 slices wholewheat bread, 1 T mayo, 3 oz tuna in water.
NutriCalc has a recipe builder — enter the recipe once, then say what serving you ate.

submission.what: The Food List Report, exported from NutriCalc as a PDF.
submission.warning: No credit is given without the Food List Report.
alternatives: Keep a paper daily food log and type it into NutriCalc afterwards, or
Use the mobile shortcut on Android or iOS and track as you go.

nonRoutineDay: At least one day off your usual routine.
note: ONE source of truth. The web app and the iOS/watchOS app both read this; implementing the rubric twice would let them drift and disagree about whether an entry counts.
